'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Cole Lepine DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: HCR v 2.0. Sheet lists 59 Reserve Deck cards (line 9 blank omitted).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness|Combat Readiness (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
